replication.target_description: Appendix D Figure 1 and p. 41: comparison of calculated humility scores between awe and neutral video conditions. Target identified by the explicit Appendix D locator; analytic N is not explicitly reported.

n.sample_role: Participant-level analytic sample; exact target-test count is not explicitly stated.
n.exclusions: 94 participants completed the study, but zero weaknesses and subsequent ratios/log transformations caused analysis-specific exclusions. The source does not give final mutually exclusive group counts for these critical tests.
n.location: pp. 40–42, Participants, Results and Limitations; p. 45, Appendices D–E
n.quote: Ninety-four participants completed the study. ... the number of excluded observations varied across calculations. ... Computations including ratios or multiple log transformations specifically

notes: Identity verified from the supplied text: A Replication Study to Evaluate the Effects of Awe on Humility; Alexandra Bertrand, Jonah Kimmel, Salomé Duhamel, Héloïse Puel, Alexandra Schifano, and Émilie Wood; DOI 10.26443/msurj.v19i1.231; Research Article, Volume 19 Issue 1 April 2024, pp. 39–45. This is the primary replication report with methods, results, discussion, references and appendices A–G, rather than an abstract-only excerpt. No PDF was supplied. Only assigned unfinished fields were examined for completion; other side/fields are placeholders. Recruitment/completion N=94 is not accepted as analytic N. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom or ICC rater-pair observation counts; no final-group arithmetic is available. The Appendix D locator independently identifies the humility condition comparison, printed t(69) = –0.34, p = 0.438. These statistics are contextual candidates only because only n_r was assigned. Appendix D gives condition means and SDs but no group counts; p. 41 gives t-test degrees of freedom, which were not used to derive N. The external calculator URL was not accessed.
